main_text.p: buisset. Et quia ex condicto cum adversario congreditur, sedatâ mente, & quidem ex intervallo, non in continenti, ut vim vi non repellat; adeo-que in nullo moderamen inculpatæ tutelæ servaverit; per allegata in seq. Idem quod dicendum de adversario,qui domum ivit, gladium petiturus. Injustam enim habuit depu-gnandi causam,quin non necef-sariam. Incurrit in periculum, quod domi manendo evitare poterat.1.6. Cod. de Pact. Unde nec in conscientiâ redire tenebatur, licet se1.7 §. generaliter D. eod. reversurum promisisset. Quod in malis fidem rescindere non sit peccatum;1.1 §. D. de Con-dit. Inst. hoc quippe nihil aliud est, quam vinculum ini-quitatis dissolvere.Fragof. loc. supr. Ne ad-dam, quod uterque vindictæ cupiditate stimulatus, propter illatas vel acceptas injurias su-alleg.less. libr.2. de just. & jur.c.9. p.94.scipiat duelli conditionem: ut neuter sit extra legis pœnam constitutus.

page.notes: Long s is printed as s throughout and is transcribed as plain s. Printed spacing errors ("adversario,qui", "poterat.Unde", "necin", "conscien-") are normalised to ordinary spacing here. The marginal notes are grouped from separate printed lines and their exact abbreviations are doubtful: "1.1 §. D. de Con-dit. Inst." and "Fragof. loc. supr." in particular. The catchword QuÆsT. is printed at the lower right, after the last line. The line-end hyphens are kept as printed.
